ent_seq.role: Sequence identifier from JMdict NG used for upstream dictionary linking and lemma cross-referencing.

kanji.source: Composite: Official Exam Corpus Ruby Markup & JMdict NG keb Elements
kanji.role: Japanese word form extracted from <ruby> tags across all 1,006 unique questions and 3,110 options, cross-referenced with JMdict standard orthography.

furigana.source: Composite: Authentic Exam Corpus <rt> Tags & JMdict NG reb Elements
furigana.role: Kana reading extracted from authentic exam ruby annotations, verified against JMdict readings with domain variants preserved.

pos.role: Part of speech entity codes (e.g. n, v5r, adj-i) extracted from upstream JMdict XML.

arti.source: SSW PM Mock Test Team (In-House Curation)
arti.role: Original Indonesian definitions contextually disambiguated for food manufacturing operations (HACCP, 5S, hygiene, machinery, safety, quality). Decoupled from proprietary application software.

occurrences.source: Local SSW PM Exam Corpus (7 bundle files)
occurrences.role: Relational mapping linking terms to question IDs, option IDs, composite keys, and target types across 27 exam packages.

thirdPartyExclusionStatement.statement: Zero Philia Space JIDict translation or lexical data is ingested, referenced, or bundled into this dataset. Because JIDict is licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0 (NonCommercial), its usage is incompatible with commercial CBT platforms. All Indonesian translations in this dataset are 100% original in-house curations.

edrdgCompliance.acknowledgement: This dataset incorporates lexical headwords and readings from JMdict New Generation, developed by the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG).

Surrounding application software, CBT scoring engine (app.js), styling (ZEN-APP-SHELL.css), and commercial subscription services are proprietary and licensed separately under the 'Mere Aggregation' principle of CC BY-SA 4.0 Section 2(a)(5)(B).

periodicUpdateProcedure.targetCadence: Monthly (recommended by EDRDG licence terms for periodically updated dictionary files)
periodicUpdateProcedure.methodology: Automated snapshot retrieval from EDRDG FTP, SHA-256 checksum verification against published archives, diff inspection for altered lemmas or readings, and semantic changelog version increments (1.x.y).

settingsModalAttribution.title: Informasi Lisensi & Atribusi Kosakata (EDRDG & SSW PM)
settingsModalAttribution.bodyText: Data leksikal bahasa Jepang (kata dasar, kanji, dan bacaan kana) bersumber dari JMdict oleh Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG) di bawah lisensi Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). Seluruh definisi bahasa Indonesia, kurasi konteks pengolahan makanan (SSW PM), dan anotasi pedagogis disusun secara mandiri oleh tim SSW PM Mock Test by Faiz di bawah lisensi CC BY-SA 4.0. Mesin ujian CBT, antarmuka aplikasi, dan hak cipta simulasi adalah milik SSW PM Mock Test by Faiz.
